Azure SQL Database's serverless compute tier
Azure SQL Managed Instance serverless mode
EC2 SQL Server with auto-shutdown

questions.explain: The min vCores floor bounds how far compute scales down before pausing; a lightly-but-constantly-busy database never pauses and bills like a small provisioned database, so serverless only wins with genuine idle periods.
options: Pause after 60 minutes of idle time
Never pause and bill like a small provisioned database
Auto-convert to an elastic pool
Refund vCore-seconds during low usage

questions.explain: RDS has no auto-pause; the chapter recommends scheduled stop/start via EventBridge Scheduler (stop at night, start in the morning), cutting dev/test compute cost by roughly two-thirds. Watch out for RDS auto-restarting instances stopped longer than 7 days.
options: Enable auto-pause on the RDS instance
Convert the instance to serverless Aurora
EventBridge-scheduled stop/start of the RDS instance
Move the databases into an elastic pool
questions.q: For RDS for SQL Server dev/test environments with business-hours usage, what is the chapter's recommended serverless equivalent?

questions.explain: The chapter's rule: below 5% utilization for more than half the week means serverless wins; if it never drops below 20%, provisioned is cheaper and more predictable; model both in between.
options: If the database is below 5% utilization for more than half the week, serverless almost certainly wins
If peak vCores exceed 16, serverless is always cheaper
If the database uses TDE, serverless is required
Serverless wins whenever there are more than 10 databases

questions.explain: The chapter lists keep-warm queries — e.g., an Azure Function or Logic App running SELECT 1 every 30 minutes during business hours — to prevent auto-pause when users are active while still allowing overnight pauses.
options: Disable auto-pause entirely during business hours
A scheduled Azure Function running SELECT 1 every 30 minutes during business hours to prevent pauses
Move the workload to Managed Instance
Set min vCores to 0
